name: Edendale
subtitle: Private movie & show library
promotionalText: Turn the movies and shows you own into a rich, private library on your Mac, with TMDB details, Continue Watching, ratings, reviews, and network shares.
description:
Edendale is a free, open-source video player and personal watch tracker for the Mac. It plays the movies and shows you already own and organises them into a rich private library: no account, no ads, no analytics.

BUILT FOR THE DESKTOP
- A full sidebar library with fast search across your movies, shows, and the people in them.
- Windowed and full-screen playback that stays out of your way.
- Optionally launch Edendale at login so your library is always ready.

PLAY ANYTHING YOU OWN
- Open individual files, import entire folders, or browse your own network shares (SMB).
- Precise playback controls with chapters, playlists, and audio and subtitle track selection.
- Search and load online subtitles on demand, or use the tracks inside your files.

A LIBRARY WITH REAL DETAIL
- Filenames are classified locally, then optionally enriched with metadata from TMDB.
- Explore movies, shows, seasons, episodes, cast, crew, release dates, and trailers.
- Trailers only open after you choose to play them.

TRACK, RATE, REVIEW
- Continue Watching remembers your place across your whole library.
- Rate titles, write private reviews, and build a Watchlist of what to watch next.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No Edendale account and no analytics. Your library and watch history stay on your Mac and the services you choose to connect.

Edendale uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
whatsNew:
Welcome to Edendale: a free, open-source video player and personal watch tracker.

- Play the movies and shows you already own, from files, folders, and your own network shares (SMB).
- Rich TMDB details for movies, shows, people, seasons, and episodes.
- Continue Watching, ratings, private reviews, and a Watchlist.
- Optionally launch at login so your library is always ready.
- Private by design: no account, no ads, no analytics.

Thank you for trying Edendale.
